race.comment: JADA ROSE (8) gets the nod after resuming with a sound fifth in stronger company at Eagle Farm. She'll find this easier and is sure to have come on from that. Good draw gives her every chance. BALTRAY (2) is a seasoned threat second-up after a narrow Ipswich third at generous odds, with interference adding merit to that run and his soft-track record a plus. SUM INVICTUS (1) has the track-and-trip win to recommend him, made ground well on the Poly last start and reunites with Allen, who won on him at their only pairing. MONTE CARLO MISS (10) drops back sharply in trip off a 56-day freshen and has peaks that measure up. Not dismissing.
